title: `streamText()` returns NaN for usage with @ai-sdk/xai

linked_prs.title: fix(providers/xai): return actual usage when streaming instead of NaN

## Background

To resolve #5736

## Summary

Added support for `includeUsage: boolean` in openai-compatible, and use this new option inside the xai provider to return proper usage instead of NaN numbers
